resume-analyzer.description:
AI-powered resume screening tool — upload up to 3 PDF resumes, specify a job position and requirements, and get per-candidate suitability scores, skill gap analysis, recruiter advice, and suggested interview questions. Includes a side-by-side candidate comparison report ranked by suitability score with strengths, weaknesses, and a final hiring recommendation. Built with Next.js and .NET Core.
* All names and data shown in screenshots are fictional and for demonstration purposes only

sales-analyzer.description:
Full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system with AI-powered analytics.

POS
  • Process sales through multiple payment channels — cash, QR code, and card
  • Dedicated POS dashboard with real-time order tracking and receipt generation
AI Analytics
  • Query products in natural language — AI extracts filters (keyword, category, price range, rating) instantly
  • AI-driven product ranking scored by ratings, review volume, and sentiment
  • Per-product review summaries with average rating breakdowns
  • Similar product recommendations
  • Full-catalog insights dashboard — top brands, underperforming products, category gaps, and pricing recommendations
  • AI responses stream in real-time via SSE
Stack: Go (chi) · PostgreSQL · Next.js · OpenRouter

personal-financial-agent.description: Personal financial advisory agent — tracks income, expenses, and gives AI-powered financial insights. Go backend API with a Next.js frontend.
